365:t_3:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...That $$ギルター$$... He's an irredeemable fool, taking such obvious bait in his rush for glory.」

365:t_3:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But I'm in luck. I meant to verify the truth about the two Reactors in $$ストラウス$$'s report, and they've come to me instead.」

365:t_3:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Heh heh... $$セツコ$$... Perhaps this, too, is fate.」

365:t_3:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I've been waiting, $$セツコ$$. I sensed you coming near.」

365:t_3:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And welcome to you, too, $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

365:t_3:10.en:
$n
「I'll pay you back for everything, $$バルビエル$$!」

365:t_3:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You came all this way to see my face just for that...? Only a fool mistakes recklessness for courage.」

365:t_3:12.en:
$n
「Don't think a taunt like that will shake me.」

365:t_3:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're saying you've grown...? Yes, I'll grant you that.」

365:t_3:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But in the end... you're just an outsider.」

365:t_3:15.en:
$n
「Then I'll use force to make sure you can't ignore me!」

365:t_3:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セツコ$$... Are you going to say you'll defeat me yourself?」

365:t_3:21.en:
$$セツコ$$
「What you're fighting for... Where your hatred comes from...」

365:t_3:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Why do you want to know?」

365:t_3:23.en:
$$セツコ$$
「When we spent time together on $$翠の地球$$... you seemed a little sad...」

365:t_3:25.en:
$n
「You're going to... reach out to someone like him...?」

365:t_3:27.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...There was a time when... hatred almost took over my heart, too, just like yours...」

365:t_3:28.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But more than anything... I was sad... that fighting like this kept going...」

365:t_3:29.en:
$$セツコ$$
「So I want to understand your heart... And the sadness inside you...」

365:t_3:30.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...$$セツコ・オハラ$$... $$悲しみの乙女$$...」

365:t_3:31.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「As I thought, your existence... cannot be allowed!」

365:t_3:33.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Normally, killing a $$リアクター$$ is forbidden... But... you're an exception...!」

365:t_3:34.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル$$! I won't let you do whatever you want to $$セツコ$$!」

365:t_3:35.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Fall back, $$セツコ$$! You're his target!」

365:t_3:38.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll test what $$ストラウス$$ reported...!」

365:t_3:39.en:
$n
「You're going to use your $$スフィア$$'s power?!」

365:t_3:40.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's right! I'll amplify the hatred sleeping in your hearts!」

365:t_3:43.en:
$n
「The $$スフィア$$s... Did $$バルビエル$$'s and $$セツコ$$'s powers collide...?!」

365:t_3:49.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That's not it! Miss $$スズネ$$ is...!」

365:t_3:52.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! Stay with us!」

365:t_3:53.en:
$n
「We're falling back, $$セツコ$$! I'll summon $$ジェニオン$$!」

365:t_3:54.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セツコ$$... You matched my power, if only for an instant...」

365:t_3:55.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Well, no matter. I've achieved my goal.」

365:t_3:56.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now I just have to wait for the poison to take effect.」

365:t_4:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!!」

365:t_4:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Get out of $$ジェニオン$$, $n! I can't let you have this machine!」

365:t_4:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's better for you... and for the world! Move!!」

365:t_5:4.en:
$$シン$$
「...So Miss $$スズネ$$ was affected by $$バルビエル$$'s poison?」

365:t_5:6.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「No... Does that mean Miss $$スズネ$$ hated $n somewhere in her heart...?」

365:t_5:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I agree with $$キラ$$. I can't believe Miss $$スズネ$$ ever felt that way.」

365:t_5:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What do you in the $$ボランティア部$$ think?」

365:t_5:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ was... abnormal then.」

365:t_5:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「Sure, she's acted a little strange from stress before, but for her to turn that violent...」

365:t_5:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yes... I think it's very likely $$バルビエル$$ used some kind of mind control.」

365:t_5:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「That bastard... He's got that power, too...?」

365:t_5:15.en:
$$シン$$
「Then... will Miss $$スズネ$$ go back to normal?」

365:t_5:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...I can't say. We don't even know how the $$スフィア$$'s power is working right now.」

365:t_5:18.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I'm sorry... If I'd... shot $$バルビエル$$ back then...」
